about: The Worca Rail design system as data: what a page can be built from, for a tool or an agent. The rules are docs/design-system.md › Worca Rail (Which component, Where things go); when this file and that section differ, the section wins and this file is fixed in the same change. Components are the Design System artifact's pages.
howToBuild: For each thing the person must see or do, find its need below; use that component in that pattern's slot.

A component with `code` is built in code: import it from ui/public/design-system/components/index.mjs and call it; never write its markup. A need with no component in code: add the component there first, with its test and its `code` entry.
Write the words by the rules in docs/design-system.md: state words, labels of 1–3 words, failures as `Could not …`, the reason, `Nothing changed.`
Draw every state: empty, loading, could not load, a failed step, an unexpected break, a lost connection, and 375px.
Set no look of your own: no size, colour, corner or shadow; they come with the component.

Lay it out narrow by docs/design-system.md › Narrow screens: at 520px of content side by side stacks on the same text edge, the action slot moves under the state word and its extra buttons fold into ⋯; nothing is dropped; names keep one line with an ellipsis and a tooltip; a branch or path loses its middle and keeps its start and last part (feat/unifi…-breadcrumb).
Name every page, menu item, section head and row by Small rules › Names: the thing, 1–3 words, one thing one name; ds-check reads them.
What a page needed and the design system did not have is added to it first: the rule, the catalog entry, the component in code with its test and gallery example; the page joins ds-check's BUILT list.
Pass the gate: plans/rail/prototype/gates/ds-check.mjs and the page's sweep.

components.name: StatusLine
needs: the one next step of a state
parts: action slot: Button primary with ▾ for alternatives
components.notFor: a second primary; buttons for the page in the top bar

components.name: Button
components.notFor: going somewhere (Text link); on or off (Switch)

components.name: CompactMenu
needs: the alternatives of a split button
rules: opened from ⋯ or ▾
danger last, after a rule

components.name: ConfirmStrip
components.place: under the top bar, in place
rules: for a step that changes what other people see (a PR, a branch, a merge, a comment) or cannot be taken back; never for spending alone
opens on the safe choice
names what goes
near a limit, a step that starts agent work adds the limit note in one line
components.notFor: a step that needs fields (Dialog); a step that can be undone (act, then Undo in a Toast)

components.name: Dialog
needs: a step that needs fields first

components.name: Text link
needs: going to another page or place

components.name: SentencePicker
needs: a choice that changes a step
rules: sits in the sentence it changes
opens a CompactMenu
on a page it takes effect at once; a failed change flips back and a Toast says why; in a Dialog it applies on submit

components.name: OptionList
components.notFor: any other single choice (SentencePicker or Segmented)

components.name: Switch
needs: a setting that is on or off
rules: takes effect at once, no confirm
a failed change flips back and a Toast says why

components.name: Segmented
needs: two or three views of the same thing
components.example: Light and Dark; Summaries and Raw

components.name: Tabs
rules: each tab is in the address
a count is a caption

components.name: Chip
needs: a short fact: a stage, a source, a slot to set up
components.example: Beta, Official, No API key; Running 4

components.name: ListEditor
needs: one pick from a long list, or a new one (single pick)
context sent with a message (removable item)

components.name: CopyButton
rules: a quiet 28px icon button
a tick for 1.2s, Copied in its tooltip and the live region
its width never changes
components.example: a branch, a command, an id

components.name: Table
needs: the same figures across many rows
rules: divided rows, no box per row
tabular figures, the name first
on a narrow screen the least needed columns move to the row's detail

components.name: Field
needs: text, a number, a pick from a long list in a form
rules: 32px
its error is a line under it

components.name: SuggestionField
parts: grey line when it could not

components.name: Stepper
needs: how far along, and its steps
parts: StepRows of the open stage on the rail

components.name: Figures
rules: each opens its own detail
numbers only

components.name: TagGroup
rules: one line, the rest in +N
one button opens the ListEditor

components.name: ListRow
parts: state mark on the rail (dot, or tick box while selecting)
time or figure at the right
rules: never a box per item
its own actions in its ⋯ (the `menu` option: moreMenu): Remove, Revoke, Delete, Uninstall and Reject last, after one rule
rows split by space; grouped by something (status, day, section), a line where each group after the first starts, from the text edge, none between rows
the whole row opens its one target

components.name: SettingsRow
needs: a setting in a settings tab
parts: one sentence: words and SentencePickers, saying the current state
end: a Switch or one quiet button, then Customise (`fold`)
folded rows under the sentence (`detailRows`): a small label over each sentence
a List of records (`detail`) and one quiet foot action (`detailAction`) in the fold
rules: one left edge for every text and section line, one right edge for every action, the name, the sentence and the end on one baseline: the component's, never the page's
takes effect at once; only a reset of many rows confirms, in the strip
under 560px of width it stacks
components.example: Badge · The tab title counts what needs you ▾

components.name: SideMenu
parts: ‹ back to where you came from
rules: it takes the sidebar's place; the sidebar's content fades over change
on a narrow screen the page's first view, as a list (`list`): 44px rows with ›, a line where each group after the first starts

components.name: Search
parts: the top bar's field: Search or ask
what it finds under it (searchResults), each with where it lives
rules: a pick lands on the thing (land): it comes into view and lights once

components.name: Trail
needs: one depth up: a thing to its place, a run to its group
rules: never names the page itself
the one way back on screen; on a narrow screen its parent alone, ‹ Parent

components.name: Pager
rules: at the top bar's right
a sibling that cannot open yet is disabled and says why

components.name: BackLink
needs: one step up, on a narrow screen

components.name: SettingsSection
parts: its one action at the head's right (a reset)
rules: the head's action ends on the rows' right edge
components.example: What reaches you · Reset to defaults

components.name: Toast
variants: warn and error: stay until closed; a repeat counts on it
rules: title at most 6 words
never moves focus
Undo for a step that can be taken back

components.name: EmptyState
needs: a part of the page cannot be drawn
rules: one line on the text edge
loading: nothing for 300ms, then one line; never a spinner or skeleton
could not load: Could not load …, the reason, Nothing changed., Try again, Details
a part that cannot be drawn: Could not show …, Reload this part, Details
empty: its one sentence, and the way forward as one quiet action
components.example: No runs yet; Could not show the changes

telling.place: where you acted: the strip, the dialog's alert, the field's error line, the suggestion's grey line; a Toast only when there is no such place
a quiet line at the end of the top bar, grey dot: Offline · retrying; then a Toast: Back online

patterns.name: A thing's page
patterns.for: any page about one thing with a state: a run, a group
slots: top bar: trail; at its right only the pager and the connection line
title
metadata line: facts as phrases, then TagGroup; a fact that is also a setting is a SentencePicker in its phrase
StatusLine with the action slot and ⋯ (empty slot when the state calls for no step)
progress: Stepper and StepRows; questions as OptionList under their step
Figures
Tabs

patterns.name: A list page
slots: top bar: trail
title row with the page's one action at its right (New schedule)
A list

patterns.name: A list
slots: the sentence of what it shows (SentencePicker): Showing [what ▾] from [where ▾] by [grouping ▾], each choice with its count; the same in every list, never a filter button or View menu
sections in a fixed order, empty sections not drawn, a line where each section after the first starts; a long section shows its newest rows, then Show N more opens the rest in place; never folded
ListRows; a fact in a row is text, never a second link; the row's own actions in a ⋯ at its right end
EmptyState when empty

patterns.name: A side column
slots: beside the page, opened from its top-bar button
pushes the page above 1080px, covers its right side from 761 to 1080px, takes the window at 760px and below
width dragged between 360 and 680px and kept
opens with the fade, closes at once; one at a time

patterns.name: A conversation
slots: the person's messages right, on --field
Worca's text on the page
its work as cards on a 760px column under the shared card head: run card, command group (a failure opens itself), graph well

patterns.name: A panel
slots: under its top-bar button, over any page
head: Tabs with counts as captions, ⋯ at the right
body that scrolls under a head that stays

patterns.name: A settings tab
slots: its title, one meta line saying what it decides
SettingsSections, each a Heading (15/600) and its one head action
SettingsRows: one per decision, its state in words, a Switch or one quiet button, then Customise; folded rows under it
a record is a ListRow in a List after the rows, its actions in its ⋯; Change… opens a Dialog with Fields
a reset or a step that cannot be taken back is the head's action and asks first in the ConfirmStrip

patterns.name: Navigation
slots: four depths: place (sidebar), thing (a row opens it as a full page), part (tabs), fact (a link, a search result, a Pulse row lands on it)
the trail goes one depth up; the pager goes to a sibling; one way back on screen, the browser's back for where you came from
a thing opens on its state, a part at its top, a fact lit once (land)
the address holds place, thing, part and fact

patterns.name: Settings
slots: opened from the profile menu only
SideMenu in the sidebar's place: ‹ Back to Worca, then Worca · Work · AI · Add-ons
each section is A settings tab
Search finds every row, folded row and record and lands on it

patterns.name: A form
slots: Dialog
the one framing sentence with SentencePickers
Fields and SuggestionFields
a problem note on the rail with an amber dot, its ways out as buttons
foot: Cancel (quiet), then the start button naming what happens

actions.kind: the one step the state calls for
actions.slot: the action slot's main; alternatives in its ▾; Stop or Cancel last, after a rule

actions.kind: supporting actions on the whole thing
actions.slot: ⋯ next to the action slot; tools, then Report, then Archive or Delete after a rule
that section's head, at its right
the fact itself, as a Figure or Text link; ⋯ only when no fact names it

actions.kind: a yes or no, or a one-line answer
a choice that changes a step
actions.slot: SentencePicker in the sentence it changes

actions.kind: a row's own detail (the ask's parts, a diff, a step's rounds)
actions.slot: opens in place under the row, › right when closed and down when open; a problem opens by itself, once (a failing test, a failed command in Chat with its output), and stays folded once the person folds it; a fact with a home elsewhere links there instead; sections never collapse

actions.kind: a list on a thing's page that is part of a step (checks, a plan)
actions.slot: one line on its StepRow (a count and the names that matter); the whole list in Overview's first section, the state's focus (What broke, The plan)

actions.kind: a list about the thing as a whole (files, decisions, activity)
actions.slot: its own tab, the count a caption on the tab; never also in the card

actions.kind: a thing's own setting (a schedule's times, a run's budget)
actions.slot: the fact itself where the page shows it, as a SentencePicker; settings that must change together: a Dialog from ⋯ (Edit schedule…); where it belongs (its group): ⋯
Settings; a thing's own settings are the thing's
a ⋯ at the row's right end

motion.rule: docs/design-system.md › Motion: motion shows what changed, never decorates; fade, never slide

timings.--motion-flash: 1.2s: the one flash after a jump

moments: a link or a search lands: the target comes into view and lights once over flash (land)
the sidebar becomes another menu: its content fades over change, the page changes at once
motion.reducedMotion: every timing 0; breathing and shimmer still
